title: Yellow Spicy Croatian Lamb Kebabs
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian dish featuring lamb, coriander, and a hint of spice, cooked to perfection in a tandoor oven. This low-calorie-friendly recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, coriander seeds, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to coat the lamb evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice and olive oil.
Place the skewers in the tandoor oven and cook for 15 minutes.
Turn the skewers over and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
